source_caption: Immaculate (2024) is a psychological horror film starring Sydney Sweeney as a devout young woman who joins a remote convent in Italy, hoping for a fresh start. However, she soon discovers that the place hides disturbing secrets, and her faith is tested as terrifying events unfold around her. Blending religious themes with suspense and horror, the film creates an eerie atmosphere filled with tension and mystery.

source_details.title: Immaculate
source_details.synopsis: Immaculate is a 2024 American horror film directed by Michael Mohan and written by Andrew Lobel. It stars Sydney Sweeney (who also produced), Álvaro Morte, Benedetta Porcaroli, Dora Romano, Giorgio Colangeli, and Simona Tabasco. The plot focuses on a young novice nun, who is invited to reside at a picturesque Italian convent, but slowly realizes the terrifying secrets it harbors. Immaculate premiered at South by Southwest on March 12, 2024, and was released theatrically in the United States by Neon on March 22, 2024. The film received mostly positive reviews and grossed $35 million worldwide.
